name: IDE Extensions

evidence.rationale: ATT&CK mentions ensuring operating systems and software are using the most current version.

Updating IDE applications can correct vulnerabilities in extension loading and provide improved extension security controls. The safeguard does not independently prevent installation of a malicious or compromised extension from an approved marketplace.

limits: A claim shows that a control can mitigate a technique. It does not show that an implementation is effective.
'none' or 'no_row' means the mapping has no mitigating control. It does not mean that no defence exists.
